text:
maya: Heads-up — post-merge canary for release/v0.42 shows decode p99 up ~2.2x on small-context chat workload. spotted in the nightly perf-run.

igor: which merge/PR?

maya: PR 4123 (fuse + kernel-chooser refactor). CI flagged a perf-failure: https://ci.internal/reports/1938123456

dev-bot: [CI] performance-check failed on job 'canary-decode-pipeline' — p99 latency spike 2.3x. artifacts: /artifacts/1938123456

sasha: can you paste a quick flame snippet? are small messages most affected?

maya: flame snippet:
```
decode_loop
  attention_kernel_slow
  memcpy_kv
  fused_op_dispatch
```

maya: profiler shows a lot of time in the slower attention kernel even for seq_len=64; KV cache miss rate +12% on canary vs baseline.

igor: sounds like the chooser heuristic routed to the fallback attn kernel. I made a heuristics change in PR 4109 to prefer memory-friendly kernels for small batches — could be related.

liam: can we bisect to narrow to the commit? also check batching threshold changes in the same patch series.

maya: starting quick local bisect. harness: `./scripts/perf/run_canary.sh --profile --seed=small-chat`

igor: I ran a bisect too — culprit seems to be commit d4e7b9 which flips the chooser precedence: prefer 'memory-friendly' over 'latency-optimized' for sub-128 seqs.

sasha: numbers from my perf run: baseline (pre-d4e7b9) p99=120ms; post-d4e7b9 p99=270ms. throughput -18%.

harper: console shows rollout blocked — canary at 40% and SLO failing. tagging @platform-oncall.

oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2026 — Canary latency regression. Incident lead: igor.

liam: mitigation options: 1) revert d4e7b9, or 2) ship a hotfix that special-cases decoder-only models to use latency-optimized kernel for seq<=128. Which is faster?

igor: I can open a hotfix PR that adds a special-case. revert means more paperwork here. I'll prioritize hotfix.

maya: note: kv-evictions also increased in canary logs — I suspect cache policy + kernel change is compounding misses. adding kv debug to hotfix tests.

igor: hotfix PR 4130 opened: adds special-case in kernel-chooser for decoder-only + seq<=128, and raises kv retention for that profile. Unit tests passing, perf job queued.

dev-bot: perf job finished for PR 4130: canary p99=125ms, delta ~+4ms vs baseline. artifacts: /artifacts/4130/perf

harper: recommendation: keep canary at 40% for 1 hour soak, then promote if stable.

sasha: provisional postmortem notes: root cause = heuristic flip in kernel-chooser + unexpected kv-eviction interaction. fix = special-case chooser + tweak kv retention for decoder-only models.

maya: adding longer soak and eval runs. thanks everyone.

liam: followups: add unit test for chooser thresholds, add regression to perf-suite, instrument kernel-decision telemetry (so we catch this routing in future).

igor: filed followups: TICKET-241 (chooser tests), TICKET-242 (perf-suite regression), TICKET-243 (kernel-decision telemetry). closing thread after canary completes.
